name: camellia oil
purpose: USES First aid to help prevent bacterial contamination or skin infection, and fortemporary relief of pain and itching associated with minor burns, scaldssunburns, cuts, and scrapes.
uses: Directions For adults and children 2 years ofage or older. Clean the affected area.Apply a small amount of the ointment to the affected area, not more than3 to 4 times daily. For children under 2 years ofage, ask a doctor before use.
otcwarn: Ask a doctor if Stop use and ask a doctor if pain worsens or persists, or if youexperience any of these symptoms: burning, itching, rash, or other changes in theskin where the product was placed.
